summary: Backend-only validation for LuxeDrive new features (surge pricing, driver assignment on accept, complete/rate flow, admin stats, lat/lng echo, legacy backfill). Wrote 40 pytest cases covering every bullet in the review request. All 40 passed against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Pricing math is exact for 1.0x / 1.25x / 1.20x / 1.45x cases (including Arabic 'مطار' airport match). Order creation ignores client-supplied price and stores server-computed base_price, surge_multiplier, surge_reasons, price. Accept endpoint requires driver_name and driver_plate (phone optional) and surfaces them to the customer via /orders/my. State machine (pending->accepted->completed, pending->rejected) and all 400/403/422 edge cases behave as specified. Admin stats correctly aggregates avg_rating and rated_count. Legacy orders without base_price are backfilled on startup and readable through /orders/my and /orders.
critical_code_review_comments: Route order check: GET /api/orders/stats is declared before GET /api/orders/{order_id} in server.py, so 'stats' is not accidentally captured as an order_id. OK.

_is_night_hour uses the hour from the parsed ISO datetime (honoring offset in the string). Spec says 'local hour' — acceptable since the frontend sends local ISO; just note for future that if clients send UTC, the night window shifts. Not a bug, but worth documenting.
Legacy backfill uses aggregation-pipeline update ($set with '$price' expression). Requires MongoDB >=4.2 (fine in current stack).
Server correctly ignores extra client fields (e.g. client-supplied price) because OrderCreate model doesn't declare it; verified in test.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own TEST_-prefixed customer accounts and orders via API. No manual DB seeding. Seeded admin (admin@luxedrive.com) used from startup seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_luxedrive.py now uses the new POST /accept /reject /complete /rate endpoints (old PATCH /status was removed). Fixtures provide admin_token, customer, customer2. Use _iso_at_hour(hour) helper to produce deterministic timestamps for surge testing. The backfill test will catch Pydantic validation errors if any legacy order rows get out of sync with the Order schema.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All features implemented as specified.
